3PL.interpretation: Bound applies to any test controlling .05 at this feasible null, not merely at the one registered reference truth. It does not prove structural parameter nonidentifiability or a global optimum. Native MAP prior is unchanged; this is an explicit feasible member of the model family.

4PL.analytic_derivation: Take a1=5,b1=-6,c1=.1,d1=m, where m=E[.1+.8 logistic(1.6(theta+1.25))] lies in(.5,.9). Couple same theta, other items and uniform first-item responses. The per-person disagreement is E[(m-.1) logistic(-5(theta+6))] <=.8 E[exp(-5theta-30)]=.8 exp(-17.5). For N independent persons TV<=N times this bound; any test of size<=.05 at this feasible null has alternative power<=.05+N*.8 exp(-17.5). This is a uniform composite-null statement, not a claim that the single registered reference cell proves uniform level.
